parameters.jsCode:
const request = $('Prepare Follow-up Tag').first().json;

return [{ json: {
  status: 'success',
  action: 'enrollment_follow_up',
  contact_id: request.contact_id,
  result_id: request.result_id,
  approval_id: request.approval_id,
  assigned_user_id: request.assigned_user_id,
  category: request.category,
  follow_up_tag: 'eny-follow-up-queued',
  notification_recipient: 'support@businessanalysisschool.com',
  notification_sent: true,
  ghl_updated: true,
  queued_at: new Date().toISOString()
} }];
